data.title: 埃塔 · 屋顶结构的勘测
data.description: 庭园据点的屋顶上，埃塔抱着图纸核对承重结构。这座据点的每一根梁都出自她的设计——睡在这里，她格外安心。
data.location: rooftop of a shadow garden hideout with exposed beams, tiles and a town view
data.action: standing on a rooftop holding blueprints, tapping a beam with her knuckles, checking its sound
data.promptProse: Eta knocks on a beam of her own design and listens. The hideout she built is the one place she sleeps soundly.
data.animaCaption: Every beam in this hideout passed through Eta's drowsy, brilliant hands.
